title: Medicine master
intro: The medicines doctors can pick from. Rows come from the NLEM 2022 import. No row has been clinically reviewed yet.
importHelp: There is no CSV upload on this page. NLEM rows are loaded by the importer script (npm run import:nlem), run by whoever looks after the server. Use this page to add, edit or retire single rows.

combobox.label: Medicine
combobox.hint: Type at least 2 letters of the generic or brand name.
combobox.empty: No medicine found. Check the spelling, or ask an admin to add it.
combobox.failed: The medicine list could not be loaded. Type again to retry.

filters.heading: Find a medicine
filters.search: Search by generic or brand name
filters.searchNote: While you search, results are ordered by best match instead of by the column you chose.

empty.title: No medicines yet
empty.description: Run the NLEM importer, or add the first medicine here.

form.addDescription: A source is required. The new row starts as Not reviewed.
form.editDescription: Change the fields below, then save.
form.clearsReview: Saving a change clears any clinical review of this medicine. It will show as Not reviewed again.
form.routeHint: Leave empty unless the source gives it.
form.sourceHint: Where this row comes from, for example the NLEM 2022 PDF.
form.sourcePageHint: The page of the PDF file. The printed page number is one lower.
form.pageInvalid: Enter a whole page number from 1 to 10000, or leave it empty.
form.yearInvalid: Enter a year from 1990 to 2100, or leave it empty.
form.duplicate: A medicine with this name, dose form, strength and route already exists.

retire.title: Retire {{name}}?
retire.body: It stops appearing in searches and cannot be added to new templates. Templates that already use it keep it and show a warning. You can restore it later.

error.loadFailed: The medicine list could not be loaded.
